# Feastpot Vendor Portal - Menu Screen Usability Test Protocol

**Version:** 1.0  
**Screen under test:** /menu (Dishes)  
**Audience:** Founder running sessions with real vendors  
**Estimated session length:** 45-60 minutes

---

## Before you begin

- Open the vendor portal on a laptop. Do not share your screen or point at controls.
- Give the participant access to the keyboard and trackpad before you start timing.
- Have a printed copy of each task card (or read it aloud). Do not show the screen during comprehension questions.
- Record on this sheet or in a notes app running on a separate device.

---

## Part 1: Task scripts

Read each task aloud exactly as written. Do not add context, gestures, or hints. If the participant asks a question, reply: "What would you do if I was not here?"

---

### Task 1 - Adding a new dish with photo and allergen information

> "Your kitchen opens this Sunday. Get your signature dish listed on Feastpot so that customers in your area can order it today. Include a photo and make sure anyone with a nut allergy can see whether it is safe for them."

**Start timing when the participant touches the keyboard or trackpad.**

| Observation                              | Notes                                         |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| Completed unaided (circle): **Yes / No** |                                               |
| Time taken (mm:ss):                      |                                               |
| Points of hesitation:                    |                                               |
| Words said aloud:                        |                                               |
| **Result: Pass / Fail**                  | Pass = completed unaided, no verbal prompting |

---

_Pass means completed unaided with no verbal prompting from the observer. A task that required a hint, a pointer, or a correction is a fail regardless of whether it was eventually completed._
